{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选以“邪修”制造开场兴趣，并提到曾接触一种纱布辅助练习，但关键动作受转写损坏且解释没有完成，实际方法与适用条件均不清楚。","candidate_id":"candidate_ecc8f9bdbcef1f0b","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","unsafe_instruction"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"讲者曾接触一种使用纱布的非常规声乐练习，但并不建议观众盲目尝试。","risk_summary":"非常规练声动作的关键措辞不清，可能涉及不安全模仿，且讲者没有给出完整说明。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"不建议盲目尝试的非常规声乐练习","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选通过高音示范对比“往后躲”和“往前唱”，明确说明唱歌中的“说”不是普通说话，而是要在稳定的发声通道中保持说话般的咬字位置。","candidate_id":"candidate_b97428705eaff8a0","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"唱高音时应保持稳定的唱歌通道和说话般的咬字位置，不能因音高变化而向前挤或向后躲。","risk_summary":"","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"用稳定的咬字与发声通道处理高音","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选先提出如何练闭口音，再从辅音、元音和含“一”音的字开始解释，教学方向可辨，但元音列举存在明显转写或表述疑点，结尾也停在举例过程中。","candidate_id":"candidate_9e9054f2deb55202","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"练闭口音前应先理解字音中的辅音和元音，并识别带闭口元音特征的字。","risk_summary":"元音名称与示例可能存在转写错误，且练习方法尚未完整展开。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"闭口音的基础概念与识别方法","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选清楚区分“教学直播间”和逐句跟唱的“学唱直播间”，并说明其流程是先听问题再给解决建议；后半段大量转为上麦、互动和下播安排，削弱了内容密度。","candidate_id":"candidate_3c92e6847aff0c59","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"该直播的教学方式是先听取学员的具体问题并提供解决思路，而不是逐句带唱。","risk_summary":"后半段包含粉丝灯牌、互动门槛和教学入口等推广性内容。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"声乐问题诊断与逐句带唱的区别","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选从课程时长转入“如何练好闭口音”，并开始解释闭口音所涉及的辅音和元音，但主体答案尚未展开，且部分字词转写不稳定。","candidate_id":"candidate_b110d906807b06f5","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"理解闭口音需要先分清字音中的辅音与元音结构。","risk_summary":"关键术语存在转写疑点，候选在给出具体练习方法前结束。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"闭口音教学的概念铺垫","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选围绕唱歌时舌头和下巴过度用力展开，利用日常说话作类比，给出保持自然、避免向后堵的建议；个别术语转写失真，但核心观点连续明确。","candidate_id":"candidate_373756f54a23ac46","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"唱歌时舌头应像说话时一样自然，舌根或下巴过度发力并向后堵会让声音紧张。","risk_summary":"内容涉及发声紧张及身体反应，且部分声乐术语的转写不确定。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"缓解唱歌时的舌根与下巴紧张","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选直接回答零基础是否需要学习看谱和乐理，明确给出“学习会更有帮助”这一立场，并以教师接触陌生歌曲为例说明识谱的用途。","candidate_id":"candidate_c512c4453cde77d1","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"零基础学唱歌并非必须先会乐理，但学习识谱会帮助更快认识和掌握歌曲。","risk_summary":"","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"零基础唱歌是否需要学习识谱和乐理","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选提出唱歌前如何开嗓，并列举打嘟等练习，最后强调应按个人习惯和老师给出的练习方法选择；开头的直播寒暄较长，降低了进入主题的速度。","candidate_id":"candidate_04479a7661739b63","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"开嗓方式因人而异，可以采用打嘟等练习，并应结合老师给出的个人练习方案选择。","risk_summary":"候选提供发声热身建议，具体适用性需要结合个人声音状况判断。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌前的个性化开嗓方式","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选区分先天音色与可调整的唱歌习惯，认为声带决定基础音色，而舌根位置和发声通道会改变实际唱出的声音；核心对比清晰，但“唱歌通道”等说法较宽泛。","candidate_id":"candidate_0650eee23c06e676","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"基础音色受声带条件影响，但可以通过调整舌根、发声习惯和唱歌通道改善唱出的声音。","risk_summary":"内容包含关于声带、音色和发声技术效果的身体机制判断。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"先天音色与可改变的发声习惯","uncertainty_flags":["claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选完整解释简谱如何提供音高和节奏信息，并进一步区分“有帮助”和“硬性要求”：不会识谱仍可通过模仿学习，但想独立快速学歌的人更值得掌握。","candidate_id":"candidate_bef585871fbac01e","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"识简谱能提高学歌速度和独立学习能力，但不会识谱也可以通过模仿学习唱歌。","risk_summary":"","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":4,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":4},"topic_hypothesis":"识简谱对学歌速度和独立学习的作用","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选先推广面向零基础唱歌人群的课程，随后解释拿着谱却跟不上伴奏，通常是因为歌曲不熟、节拍感不足，注意力又同时被音高与节奏占用；个别节奏术语转写不清。","candidate_id":"candidate_6721fcbb3782d23b","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"拿着简谱仍跟不上伴奏，往往是因为歌曲不够熟，无法同时兼顾音高、节奏和伴奏中的律动。","risk_summary":"候选含明显课程推广内容，且部分节奏相关词语存在转写不确定。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"识谱后仍跟不上伴奏的原因","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选说明高音卡挤既可能与个人条件有关，也可能源于技术或发声位置，并把声带结节、息肉等情况列为特殊情形；后半段医学名词转写受损且结论未完整说完。","candidate_id":"candidate_5b457445f2236f35","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"高音卡挤不一定只是音域问题，可能通过技术训练改善，但声带存在异常时应区别对待。","risk_summary":"内容涉及声带异常与训练适用性的健康判断，相关医学词语转写不稳，结论也未完整收束。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"高音卡挤的技术原因与声带状况","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选主要说明声音诊断需要通过连麦听到学员实际发声，并引导观众完成直播互动操作；观点可辨，但缺少具体诊断内容，独立观看价值较低。","candidate_id":"candidate_f3d1b16dd252adfd","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"要进行声音问题诊断，讲者需要先通过连麦听到对方的实际声音。","risk_summary":"内容主要用于引导连麦、关注和粉丝灯牌等直播互动。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"连麦进行声音问题诊断","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选把高音卡挤和疲劳归因于腰腹气息支撑不足、主要依靠嗓子机能发声，并通过询问下半身是否有感觉来帮助自查；中后段突然转向共鸣与连麦安排，收束较弱。","candidate_id":"candidate_0c9ab3b5a64030d5","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"唱高音时如果没有使用腰腹气息支撑，而主要依靠嗓子发力，就容易卡挤并感到疲劳。","risk_summary":"内容对高音卡挤和疲劳给出身体机制解释，但论述在转入其他话题前没有完整收束。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"气息支撑不足导致高音卡挤","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选直接回答换声区不断层的问题，给出统一咬字位置、持续保持发声通道的原则，并用高音时向前挤或向后躲的反例说明声音为何不统一。","candidate_id":"candidate_2169870825746d02","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"要让换声区声音不断层，应保持咬字位置和发声通道统一，避免高音时向前挤或向后躲。","risk_summary":"","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"保持换声区声音位置统一","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
